# Ayaz Aftab — Digital Marketing & eCommerce Growth Specialist

> Official portfolio of Ayaz Aftab, a results-driven Digital Marketing & eCommerce Growth Specialist with 5+ years of experience scaling revenue via Technical & Local SEO, Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max), Meta Ads lead generation funnels, Amazon Seller Central A+ optimization, YouTube SEO, and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO).

## Key Verified Career Metrics

- **15,000+ Qualified Leads Generated**: Full-funnel acquisition across Google Ads and Meta Ads.
- **₹7.95 Lakhs+ Amazon Marketplace Revenue**: Driven via Amazon Seller Central catalog management, keyword-indexed A+ content, and marketplace PPC.
- **+30% Organic Search Traffic Lift**: Achieved through Technical SEO, on-page semantic optimization, and high-intent commercial content strategy.
- **247,000+ Organic YouTube Views**: 5,200+ hours of watch time built from the ground up using YouTube search trend analysis and video SEO.
- **₹49.86 Average Cost Per Lead (CPL)**: Delivered 9,452 student admissions leads across ₹4.7 Lakhs in managed Meta Ads spend.
